attchmntText: Aries Agro Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Aries Agro Limited approved un-audited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The board meeting was held on 13th November 2026. Consolidated net income from operations for the three months ended 30th September 2026 was 23,345.86. Standalone net income from operations for the same period was 24,695.84. Consolidated profit after tax for the three months ended 30th September 2026 was 728.52. Standalone profit after tax for the same period was 873.79. Year to date consolidated net income from operations was 41,680.60. Year to date standalone net income from operations was 43,454.32. Year to date consolidated profit after tax was 1,175.71. Year to date standalone profit after tax was 1,351.59. The limited review report by statutory auditors is enclosed.

attchmntText: Aries Agro Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Monthly Report on Special Window Re-lodgement of Shares- October 2026 '.
voiceSummary: Aries Agro Limited filed a monthly report on the special window re-lodgement of shares for October 2026. The company received no requests for the re-lodgement of physical share transfer requests during the month. Consequently, the number of requests approved, rejected, processed, and received was nil. The average time taken for processing requests was also nil. This intimation was submitted to the BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited pursuant to SEBI circular dated January 30, 2026. The report was signed by Qaiser P. Ansari, Company Secretary and Chief Legal Officer of Aries Agro Limited. The status was confirmed by Jagan Mohan Gobburi, Compliance Officer of Aarthi Consultants Pvt Ltd, the Registrar and Share Transfer Agent.
